title: Per-project CSV export ZIP
summary: Added admin System UI + CLI to export one Library project as a ZIP of CSVs including core modules, audit_log, notifications, and linked user sessions/API token metadata, with optional PII redaction.
notes: Optional --redact / UI checkbox redacts names, address, age, contact, email (and related JSON keys).
profile_structure_tags ordered by profile_id, sort_order, structure_tag (not structure_id).
